tasks.short: Record spa cash flow, prepare deposits and generate financial statements.

steps.what: Count actual cash and reconcile spa receipts, refunds, card settlements and discrepancies
inputs: actual cash and spa point-of-sale receipts
actual refunds, bank settlements and accounting requirements
outputs: actual counted cash, checked source transactions and unresolved differences

steps.what: Transfer actual point-of-sale and bank transaction fields into daily cash-flow draft
inputs: actual counted cash, checked source transactions and unresolved differences
actual source transaction identifiers, dates, amounts and settlement statuses
outputs: source-linked actual daily cash-flow draft

steps.what: Prepare actual bank deposit slip and bag from counted cash and chosen deposit amount
inputs: actual counted cash, checked source transactions and unresolved differences
actual chosen deposit amount and approved bank destination
outputs: actual prepared cash bag and deposit slip draft

steps.what: Check final cash-flow entries, deposit cash/slip, account, amounts, duplicates and actual authority
inputs: source-linked actual daily cash-flow draft
actual prepared cash bag and deposit slip draft
actual counted cash, checked source transactions and unresolved differences
outputs: checked final cash-flow entries and exact deposit cash/slip/account

steps.what: Post exact checked daily cash-flow entries to actual accounting ledger
inputs: checked final cash-flow entries and exact deposit cash/slip/account
outputs: actual posted daily cash-flow ledger

steps.what: Physically prepare and transport actual checked deposit cash using actual authorised route
inputs: checked final cash-flow entries and exact deposit cash/slip/account
actual authorised cash-handling route
outputs: actual checked cash deposit ready at authorised deposit point

steps.what: Deposit exact checked cash and slip to actual authorised bank destination
inputs: actual checked cash deposit ready at authorised deposit point
checked final cash-flow entries and exact deposit cash/slip/account
outputs: actual deposit handed over and bank receipt if issued

steps.what: Generate actual financial statement draft from posted ledger and selected period
inputs: actual posted daily cash-flow ledger
actual complete period ledger and chosen statement definition
outputs: source-linked actual financial statement draft

steps.what: Check complete final financial statement, period completeness, balances and actual accounting treatment
inputs: source-linked actual financial statement draft
actual complete period ledger and accounting requirements
outputs: checked final actual financial statement and record destination

steps.what: Save exact checked final spa financial statement
inputs: checked final actual financial statement and record destination
outputs: saved actual financial statement

tasks.design: Configure native point-of-sale/bank imports and statements in {ERP}, with spa receipts in {OPS_SYSTEM} and deposit fields in {BANK}. Retain actual cash reconciliation, handling and complete financial checks; posting, bank handover and final statement save are separate gated actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual transaction fields, deposit fields and statements may be manually recopied or assembled.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports, deposit fields and statement definitions can reduce repeated transcription and arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Actual cash, discrepancies and correct accounting treatment require verification.
tasks.human_edge: The manager investigates a cash difference instead of forcing a matching balance.
tasks.altitude: Remove repeated finance transcription; retain cash and accounting responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native point-of-sale/bank imports and accounting statements can reduce repeated transcription; they do not count cash or validate an unexplained difference.

assumptions: Actual point-of-sale, bank and ledger produce transaction identifier, date, amount, currency and settlement/reversal status. S1 counts physical cash and resolves actual differences; s2 deduplicates and preserves source links, leaving missing/unmatched fields manual.

S3 reduces deposit-field copying/arithmetic only; actual cash selection, bag preparation and complete check remain. S6 retains physical handling/travel; s7 handover uses exact checked cash/slip/account, rechecked if altered. Deposit does not imply bank credit before actual bank evidence.

S8 uses actual posted complete period ledger and manager-chosen statement definition; s9 retains all period/balance/treatment checks. Actual cash-flow, deposit and statement duties may be alternative/periodic branches; reweight actual frequency and omit unowned branches rather than assigning them every day.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Only actual manager labour included; native imports/reports already running earn zero new saving. Saves/handover each retain one percent using existing checks. Any actual statement distribution or deposit-receipt posting is a separately checked final action; no avoided labour claimed.
unknowns: Which actual finance imports and statements remain manual?
research_questions: Can native imports reduce duplication after full cash, source and accounting checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual transaction mapping, deduplication and statement definitions.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact checked final cash-flow entries and actual ledger destination; edits require recheck
s4 exact checked cash bag, deposit slip, amount and bank account; any alteration requires recheck before handover
s9 checked final actual financial statement and exact record destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 actual duplicated transfer + 15*0.50 deposit fields + 10 manual statement assembly = 37.5; minus 1.5 upkeep = 36. Half eligible gives 18.75 minus 1.5 = 17.25. Actual cash, exceptions, physical handling, full checks and posting/handover/save retained.

actual manager-chosen scheduling priorities
outputs: actual constraint-checked facility schedule draft

steps.what: Resolve actual scheduling conflicts and check complete final schedule, staff and facility destinations
inputs: actual constraint-checked facility schedule draft
actual staff/client constraints and exceptions
outputs: checked final actual facility schedule and permitted recipients

tasks.design: Configure native booking/resource scheduling in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {CALENDAR} using actual qualification/availability records in {HCM}. Retain conflict negotiation and complete final schedule checking before separate calendar commit and staff notification through {CHAT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Facility scheduling can repeat availability lookup and manual slot assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native resource/duration/buffer constraints can produce schedule options.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected service needs and staff/client conflicts require actual resolution.
tasks.human_edge: The manager balances efficiency against realistic service and cleanup conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less schedule assembly; service coordination stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native spa resource calendars can use durations, buffers and availability to propose schedules; they do not resolve unrecorded staff/client needs.

assumptions: Actual booking owners, staff and facility owners produce availability; actual service owners supply duration/cleanup and qualification requirements. S1 checks freshness; missing constraints require actual clarification, not inferred availability.

S2 reduces manual slot assembly only; manager chooses priorities and retains exceptions. S3 retains all actual conflict discussions and full final constraint checking. Actual client rebooking messages, if required, are separately final-content gated sends with no avoided labour claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native scheduling first; existing auto-scheduling earns zero new saving. Save/notice each retain one percent using existing checking. No employee ranking or inferred performance used.
unknowns: Which actual scheduling work remains manual?
research_questions: Can native constraints reduce assembly after complete availability and conflict checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual resource, duration and qualification constraints.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final facility schedule and exact calendar destination; edits require recheck
s3 exact final facility schedule and authorised staff recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 lookup + 35*0.50 manual slot assembly = 25.5; minus 1 upkeep = 24.5. Half eligible gives 12.75 minus 1 = 11.75. Actual priorities, conflict resolution, full checks and save/notice retained.

tasks.design: Configure native role/prior-action links in {HCM} and {DOCS}. Retain actual performance assessment, employee discussion and new written record capture/check before separate save and employee delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessment preparation can repeat role and prior-action navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Fair work assessment and useful development advice need actual evidence and discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The manager understands circumstances behind an apparent performance problem.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence lookup; staff assessment stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native role/prior-action links can assist preparation; they do not assess employees or infer performance scores.

assumptions: Actual manager observations and employee account produce performance evidence; no inference from booking utilisation. S1 retains source verification; s2 retains all actual assessment and suggestions.

S3 retains new assessment capture and complete fairness/context checking. Written record/delivery only if actual; informal feedback removes unused branches and reweights. No new employee scoring or automated employment decision.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Save/delivery each retain one percent using existing checking.
research_questions: Can native links reduce preparation after full evidence/context checking?

s3 exact final actual written assessment and intended employee; edits void approval

tasks.short: Monitor spa health, safety and hygiene compliance.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual applicable health/safety/hygiene standards and current spa inspection records
inputs: actual spa services and facility
actual current applicable standards and previous inspection records
outputs: checked actual compliance requirements and inspection context

steps.what: Inspect actual operations and assess health, safety and hygiene conditions and control failures
inputs: checked actual compliance requirements and inspection context
actual observed cleaning, treatment, equipment and handling conditions
outputs: actual captured compliance findings and chosen follow-up

steps.what: Record and check actual inspection findings using native location and standard-version fields
inputs: actual captured compliance findings and chosen follow-up
checked actual compliance requirements and inspection context
outputs: checked final actual spa compliance inspection record

steps.what: Commit checked actual health/safety/hygiene inspection record
inputs: checked final actual spa compliance inspection record
outputs: saved actual spa inspection findings

tasks.design: Configure native standards/location links and inspection fields in {DOCS} and {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retain actual physical inspection and compliance judgement, with all new findings capture/check before a separate record commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Compliance checks can repeat current-standard retrieval and stable inspection identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native standard/location fields can reduce repeated administration.
tasks.still_hard: Actual hygiene and safety failures require observation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager notices unsafe practice despite a completed cleaning checklist.
tasks.altitude: Less inspection administration; physical compliance checks stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native standards/location fields can support inspection records; they do not observe hygiene or establish compliance.

assumptions: Actual standards owners provide current requirements; manager verifies applicability in s1 and produces all new actual observations in retained s2. A scheduled/completed checklist never proves cleaning or compliance.

S3 cuts stable location/standard identifiers only; all new findings and complete source/meaning checking remain. Actual corrective instructions/escalations, if required, are separately final-content checked sends, and actual corrective physical work remains retained with no avoided labour claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native fields first; existing checklist/prefill earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing checking; shared staff/inspection evidence counted once.
unknowns: Which inspection identifiers and requirement lookup repeat?
research_questions: Can native fields reduce entry after complete physical and requirement checking?
